C/EBPβ is a critical transcriptional factor for the LPS-induced production of IL-6 in P388 cells.
serine 64 is a critical phosphoacceptor for C/EBPβ activity.

the role of the transcription factor C/EBP beta in the regulation of proinflammatory genes.
understanding the mechanisms by which the transcription factor C/EBPβ regulates the expression of pro-inflammatory mediators.
the role of C/EBPs in the regulation of proinflammatory genes.

the integrity of serine-64 along with threnine-189 in C/EBPa is critical for LPS-induced transcriptional activity of C/EBPa in P388 cells.

the serine 64 site is critical for C/EBPβ activity in the transcriptional regulation of IL-6.
